# AML Detection and Regulatory Compliance Review

This document outlines key initiatives for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Optimize Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection for Strategy 2026.
*   Conduct quarterly reviews of internal controls.
*   Update AML detection standards.
*   Investigate and update regulatory changes standards.
*   Review and update regulatory changes on a quarterly basis.
